summary: Groomed the 4 open alpha-phase items touching the grooming loop. Proposes #2235 first (it blocks the rest of E54), flags one duplicate pair, one unboarded Jira item, one directional dependency, and one non-goal drift.

rubric_citations.quote: Blocks two or more other items, or blocks an entire epic's critical path.
rubric_citations.note: The grooming_report artifact kind blocks #2236 and #2240.
Every later groomer surface is written against this shape; retrofitting it gets more expensive per consumer.

ordering.rationale: Keystone of E54: nothing downstream can be declared or diffed until the artifact kind exists.

rubric_citations.note: On the critical path of E54, the current phase's tracking epic.
Real value, wrong phase — ranked below the alpha-blocking items and said so.
Blocks nothing and nothing blocks it; scheduled on value alone.

duplicates.basis: Both describe run-over-run report comparison; #2240 supersedes the churn-guard half of #2236's body.

hygiene_defects.detail: Not present on the tracking board, so it is invisible to the kanban view the phase is driven from.
hygiene_defects.suggested_fix: Add the item to the phase board and set Status=Backlog.

dependency_edges.basis: The churn guard diffs two grooming reports, so it cannot be built before the report artifact exists.

vision_drift.detail: Proposes a hosted multi-tenant control plane, which the charter names as a non-goal for the current phase.

decomposition_suggestions.rationale: The body couples the workflow declaration to the apply-stage mutation path; they land on different gates and should not share one review.
